title: Understanding Ridge Regression
text: Ridge regression is a type of linear regression that includes a regularization term. This term is controlled by the hyperparameter lambda (λ).

title: Effect of Increasing Lambda
text: Increasing the value of lambda (λ) in ridge regression affects the estimated parameters. Consider how the regularization term impacts the model complexity.

title: Regularization Term in Ridge Regression
text: The regularization term in ridge regression is λ times the sum of the squares of the coefficients. Increasing λ penalizes larger coefficients more heavily.

title: Impact on Estimated Parameters
text: As λ increases, the penalty on the size of the coefficients increases, leading to smaller estimated coefficients. This means the estimated parameter \hat{\theta} becomes smaller.
